scenario: Automation credential permits broad user administration
proposed_treatment: Keep in isolated workforce realm; no realm-admin; store privately and rotate
validation_required: Inspect roles and prove employee has no admin privileges

scenario: Local HTTP and development hosting expose credentials if made public
proposed_treatment: Bind loopback only; never publish; HTTPS and hardened hosting required for production
validation_required: Inspect bindings; verify no intentional external exposure

scenario: Local reports and audit database can be modified by operator
proposed_treatment: Retain raw exports privately; sanitize copies; track hashes and source metadata
validation_required: Trace each evidence item to its source; document no independent integrity guarantee

scenario: CSV reviewer identity can be impersonated by local operator
proposed_treatment: Use isolated synthetic lab; runtime expiry and self-approval check; authenticated approval needed for production
validation_required: Test rejection and expiry; document role-played approval boundary

scenario: HR CSV is stale or contains wrong department/status
proposed_treatment: Approved snapshot; validate input; preserve correlation; reconcile with HR decisions
validation_required: Bad-data rejection and before/after role tests

proposed_treatment: Treat device trust as explicit scope gap; design trusted endpoint signals for future work
validation_required: Review limitations; do not claim device compliance implemented

scenario: Partial reconciliation leaves different state across systems
proposed_treatment: Stop on failure; log affected identity; inspect and rerun approved state
validation_required: Deliberate target failure and read-back recovery exercise

scenario: Obsolete tokens or sessions remain in an untested downstream application
proposed_treatment: Test new/existing sessions; inventory token owners; apply target-specific revocation
validation_required: Leaver browser tests and explicit session boundary analysis
